abathur.def: A high Mandaean uthra, the 'Ancient' or 'Father of the Uthras'; he sits at the boundary weighing the souls of the dead and is the father of Ptahil.

abatur.def: A high Mandaean uthra, the 'Ancient' or 'Father of the Uthras'; he sits at the boundary weighing the souls of the dead and is the father of Ptahil.

abel.def: The second son of Adam and Eve; in some Gnostic accounts also of archontic origin, set over parts of the lower world after his death.

abortion.def: A term for the formless, deficient offspring produced by Sophia apart from her consort, cast outside the Fullness before being given shape.

abrasaks.def: A great light-angel or power in Sethian texts serving the Luminary Eleleth; the name also functions numerologically (its Greek letters summing to 365) as a designation of cosmic totality.

abrasax.def: A great light-angel or power in Sethian texts serving the Luminary Eleleth; the name also functions numerologically (its Greek letters summing to 365) as a designation of cosmic totality.

abraxas.def: A great light-angel or power in Sethian texts serving the Luminary Eleleth; the name also functions numerologically (its Greek letters summing to 365) as a designation of cosmic totality.

achamoth.def: The lower Sophia in Valentinian myth; the offspring or 'passion' of the higher Wisdom, cast outside the Fullness, whose emotions form the material world and who is later given shape.

adam.def: The first earthly human, molded by the Archons after the image of the heavenly Human but unable to rise until the divine spark and Epinoia are placed in him.

adamas.def: The heavenly, perfect primal Human (Pigeradamas, the 'holy Adam'); the divine archetype of humanity within the Pleroma, distinct from the earthly Adam.

adonaios.def: One of the Archons or authorities generated by Yaldabaoth; a ruler-name derived from the Hebrew divine title Adonai.

aeon.def: In Gnostic thought, an eternal being or realm emanated from the ultimate God; the Aeons collectively make up the spiritual Fullness (Pleroma) and are often paired as male-female couples.

afterthought.def: 'Afterthought' or insight; a luminous feminine power sent to dwell in Adam (the 'Epinoia of light', linked to Life/Zoe) to awaken humanity to knowledge.

agnosia.def: 'Ignorance'; the lack of saving knowledge that binds the soul to matter and the rulers, the condition Gnosis overcomes.

aisthesis.def: 'Sense-perception'; the faculty of bodily sensation, sometimes personified as one of the psychic powers shaping the material human.

aletheia.def: 'Truth'; a primal Aeon, frequently the female consort of Mind (Nous) in the founding Tetrad of the Valentinian Pleroma.

all.def: The totality of divine being, the Entirety; a term for the sum of the Aeons and the Fullness taken as one whole.

allogenes.def: 'The Stranger' or 'One of Another Race'; a Sethian visionary (a name for Seth or his seed) who ascends through the Aeons and receives revelation of the Unknowable God.

allogenes the stranger.def: 'The Stranger' or 'One of Another Race'; a Sethian visionary (a name for Seth or his seed) who ascends through the Aeons and receives revelation of the Unknowable God.

anapausis.def: 'Rest' or repose; the state of final tranquility and fulfillment attained by the redeemed soul upon returning to the Fullness.

ancient of days.def: A biblical title for the supreme God as the aged, primordial One; in Gnostic and later usage a name for the transcendent Father or, polemically, misapplied to the Demiurge.

anthropos.def: 'Man'; a heavenly Aeon and the archetypal divine Human, the celestial pattern after whom the earthly Adam is modeled.

antimimon pneuma.def: The 'imitation spirit' fashioned by the Archons to bind souls to matter through the passions, deceiving them and hindering their ascent.

anush.def: A Mandaean uthra (light-being) corresponding to the biblical Enosh; a savior-figure who appears in the world to reveal truth and confound false powers.

anush uthra.def: A Mandaean uthra (light-being) corresponding to the biblical Enosh; a savior-figure who appears in the world to reveal truth and confound false powers.

apocatastasis.def: The final 'Restoration'; the ultimate return of all fallen spiritual elements to the Fullness and the healing of every deficiency.

apokatastasis.def: The final 'Restoration'; the ultimate return of all fallen spiritual elements to the Fullness and the healing of every deficiency.

archetype.def: The original heavenly pattern or model after which a lower thing is made; the perfect prototype standing behind its earthly image.

archon.def: A 'ruler'; one of the cosmic powers, typically seven or twelve, who govern the material world and heavens under the Demiurge and hold souls captive.

ariael.def: The chief Archon and Demiurge, lion-faced offspring of Sophia; ignorant of the realm above, he arrogantly declares himself the only God and creates the lower cosmos and its rulers.

armozel.def: The first of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten; the light-realm where the perfect Adamas is established.

astaphaios.def: One of the seven planetary Archons subordinate to Yaldabaoth in the Sethian ruler-lists.

authority.def: One of the cosmic powers (exousia) ranked among the rulers; a hostile governing force of the lower world, as in the tractate 'The Hypostasis of the Archons' (Reality of the Rulers).

autogenes.def: The 'Self-Begotten' or Self-Generated One; the divine Son who arises within Barbelo, often identified with the heavenly Christ, surrounded by the four Luminaries.

baptism (gnostic).def: A Sethian baptismal rite and mystery of enlightenment; a fivefold sealing that confers illumination, protection, and incorporation into the realm of light.

barbelo.def: The first emanation of the Invisible Spirit and supreme Mother-Father figure of Sethian myth; the divine Forethought (Pronoia) and womb of the All from whom the Aeons flow.

barbelo-aeon.def: The first emanation of the Invisible Spirit and supreme Mother-Father figure of Sethian myth; the divine Forethought (Pronoia) and womb of the All from whom the Aeons flow.

beloved.def: A title for the Only-Begotten or Christ as the cherished Son emanated to reveal the Father within the Fullness.

bridal chamber.def: A central Valentinian sacrament and symbol; the mystery of reunion in which the soul is joined with its angelic or spiritual counterpart, restoring the lost syzygy.

bridalchamber.def: A central Valentinian sacrament and symbol; the mystery of reunion in which the soul is joined with its angelic or spiritual counterpart, restoring the lost syzygy.

bythos.def: The 'Depth' or 'Abyss'; the unknowable primal Father and ultimate origin of all things in Valentinian cosmology, often paired with Silence.

bythus.def: The 'Depth' or 'Abyss'; the unknowable primal Father and ultimate origin of all things in Valentinian cosmology, often paired with Silence.

cain.def: The first son of Adam and Eve; in some Gnostic readings begotten by the Archons (Yaldabaoth), representing a lower, ruler-derived lineage.

chaos.def: The dark, formless, watery abyss below the ordered world from which matter derives; the region into which the aborted lower Sophia or the deficiency is cast.

christ.def: The 'Anointed'; the heavenly redeemer and revealer of Gnosis, frequently identified with the Self-Begotten (Autogenes) or a saving Aeon who descends to awaken humanity.

church.def: 'Church' or assembly; a heavenly Aeon in the Pleroma (paired with Man/Anthropos) representing the spiritual community of the elect, prototype of the earthly church.

column of glory.def: In Manichaean cosmology the luminous pillar (associated with the Milky Way) up which liberated light-particles and purified souls ascend from the world toward the realm of light.

cosmocrator.def: The 'World-Ruler'; a title for the Demiurge or a chief archon as governor of the material cosmos, sometimes identified with the ruler of darkness.

cosmos.def: The ordered material universe; in Gnostic thought a lower, often flawed or prison-like realm fashioned by the Demiurge, contrasted with the spiritual Fullness.

counterfeit spirit.def: The 'imitation spirit' fashioned by the Archons to bind souls to matter through the passions, deceiving them and hindering their ascent.

cross (gnostic).def: The 'Cross'; in Valentinian usage a limiting and stabilizing power (identified with Horos/Limit) that fences the Fullness and supports the Aeons, distinct from the wooden cross.

darkness.def: The primordial realm or power opposed to the light; in dualist systems a coeternal evil principle, in others the ignorance and matter below the Fullness.

daveithai.def: The third of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten in Sethian myth, associated with one of the heavenly Adam-figures.

daveithe.def: The third of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten in Sethian myth, associated with one of the heavenly Adam-figures.

daveithi.def: The third of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten in Sethian myth, associated with one of the heavenly Adam-figures.

davithe.def: The third of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten in Sethian myth, associated with one of the heavenly Adam-figures.

decad.def: A group of ten Aeons within the Pleroma, a numbered emanation-set in Valentinian cosmology.

deficiency.def: The state of lack, incompleteness, or ignorance that characterizes the material cosmos and results from Sophia's fall; contrasted with the Fullness.

demiurge.def: The 'craftsman' who fashions and rules the material cosmos; in Gnostic myth an ignorant or arrogant lower god (often Yaldabaoth), born of Sophia, mistaken for the true God.

depth.def: An English rendering of Bythos; the unfathomable primal Father, ultimate abyss-like source of the Aeons.

derdekea.def: The heavenly savior and revealer in the tractate 'The Paraphrase of Shem', a luminous being sent from the light to redeem the spiritual element from darkness.

derdekeas.def: The heavenly savior and revealer in the tractate 'The Paraphrase of Shem', a luminous being sent from the light to redeem the spiritual element from darkness.

didymos judas thomas.def: The apostle 'Thomas the Twin', presented in the Gospel of Thomas and related texts as the recipient and transmitter of Jesus' hidden sayings.

divine spark.def: The fragment of divine light or spirit trapped within a human being; awakening this spark through Gnosis is the aim of Gnostic salvation.

dodecad.def: A group of twelve Aeons within the Pleroma; Sophia is often reckoned the twelfth and last of this group.

dyad.def: A twofold principle or pair; the first duality that arises from the Monad, often a male-female first couple.

earthly adam.def: The first earthly human, molded by the Archons after the image of the heavenly Human but unable to rise until the divine spark and Epinoia are placed in him.

ecclesia.def: 'Church' or assembly; a heavenly Aeon in the Pleroma (paired with Man/Anthropos) representing the spiritual community of the elect, prototype of the earthly church.

eighth and ninth.def: The eighth and ninth heavenly spheres in Hermetic mysticism; realms of light and praise above the seven planetary heavens, reached in a visionary ascent (as in the tractate 'The Discourse on the Eighth and Ninth').

elect.def: The spiritually mature believers (especially in Manichaeism) who bear and liberate the light and are assured of return to the realm of light.

eleleth.def: The fourth of the four Luminaries in Sethian cosmology; the light-realm ('Prudence') from whose domain the drama of Sophia and the Demiurge unfolds.

eleleth luminary.def: The fourth of the four Luminaries in Sethian cosmology; the light-realm ('Prudence') from whose domain the drama of Sophia and the Demiurge unfolds.

eloaios.def: One of the seven Archons under Yaldabaoth, whose name derives from a Hebrew word for God (Eloah).

emanation.def: The process by which lower spiritual beings or realms flow forth from a higher divine source, as light radiates from a lamp, without diminishing the source.

ennead.def: The ninth sphere or heaven in Hermetic cosmology, a realm of the divine reached beyond the Ogdoad in the mystic's ascent.

ennoia.def: 'Thought' or intention; the first conception within the divine Mind, a feminine principle that is the Father's inward thought of himself.

enosh.def: A Mandaean uthra (light-being) corresponding to the biblical Enosh; a savior-figure who appears in the world to reveal truth and confound false powers.

entirety.def: The totality of divine being, the Entirety; a term for the sum of the Aeons and the Fullness taken as one whole.

epinoia.def: 'Afterthought' or insight; a luminous feminine power sent to dwell in Adam (the 'Epinoia of light', linked to Life/Zoe) to awaken humanity to knowledge.

eve.def: The first woman; in Gnostic myth often a spiritual figure (linked with Zoe/Life and the Epinoia of light) who awakens Adam to knowledge, distinguished from the merely fleshly Eve.

faith.def: 'Faith'; a divine feminine power (often 'Pistis Sophia', Faith-Wisdom) of the higher realm whose reflection in the waters below the Demiurge unwittingly imitates.

fall.def: The primal error, especially Sophia's misguided desire, that produces deficiency, the Demiurge, and the material world; the disruption whose repair is the goal of the drama.

fate.def: 'Fate'; the oppressive cosmic determinism imposed by the planetary Archons over the material world, binding souls until Gnosis frees them.

father.def: The ultimate, unbegotten source of all divine being; the transcendent origin beyond name and comprehension in Gnostic theology.

father of greatness.def: The supreme good God of Manichaeism, ruler of the Realm of Light, who initiates the series of divine evocations to combat the invading darkness.

first man (manichaean).def: The first evoked being in Manichaean cosmology, sent to battle the darkness; defeated and stripped of his light-armor, his rescue and the recovery of the lost light drive the cosmic drama.

first thought.def: The 'First Thought' of the Father; a primal feminine emanation who descends through the realms as a revealer and savior, central to the text Trimorphic Protennoia.

five seals.def: A Sethian baptismal rite and mystery of enlightenment; a fivefold sealing that confers illumination, protection, and incorporation into the realm of light.

flesh.def: 'Flesh'; the physical, fleshly body, associated with the material realm and the passions, often disparaged in Gnostic anthropology.

fore-father.def: The 'Fore-Father'; the primal ancestral God before all Aeons, another name for the ineffable source (Bythos) of the Fullness.

forefather.def: The 'Fore-Father'; the primal ancestral God before all Aeons, another name for the ineffable source (Bythos) of the Fullness.

forethought.def: 'Forethought' or Providence; a divine feminine power, often identified with Barbelo, whose provident care descends to awaken and rescue the sparks of light.

fullness.def: An English rendering of Pleroma; the totality of the divine spiritual world containing all the Aeons.

gamaliel.def: One of the great light-angels and ministers of the Luminaries in Sethian cosmology, a servant of Harmozel who helps gather the elect.

gamaliel (angel).def: One of the great light-angels and ministers of the Luminaries in Sethian cosmology, a servant of Harmozel who helps gather the elect.

geradamas.def: The heavenly, perfect primal Human (Pigeradamas, the 'holy Adam'); the divine archetype of humanity within the Pleroma, distinct from the earthly Adam.

gnosis.def: Saving 'knowledge'; a direct, revelatory acquaintance with the divine and with one's own true origin that liberates the soul from the material world.

gnostic jesus.def: In Gnostic texts the earthly manifestation joined by or vehicle of the heavenly Christ/Savior, who teaches secret Gnosis to the disciples rather than dying for sin in the orthodox sense.

grace.def: 'Charis'; a divine Aeon and gift, sometimes paired with the Only-Begotten, expressing the freely given favor of the Fullness.

great life.def: The supreme deity of the Mandaeans (the 'Great Life' or 'First Life'), the ineffable source of the World of Light from whom the uthras and all goodness proceed.

great nous.def: In Manichaeism the supreme saving Mind, the redeeming intelligence sent to awaken and organize the Light-Mind within the elect.

great seth.def: The heavenly and earthly son of Adam revered as the spiritual father and savior of the Gnostic race (the 'seed of Seth'); the Great Seth is his exalted heavenly counterpart.

hachamoth.def: The lower Sophia in Valentinian myth; the offspring or 'passion' of the higher Wisdom, cast outside the Fullness, whose emotions form the material world and who is later given shape.

harmozael.def: The first of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten; the light-realm where the perfect Adamas is established.

harmozel.def: The first of the four Luminaries surrounding the Self-Begotten; the light-realm where the perfect Adamas is established.

hayye.def: The supreme deity of the Mandaeans (the 'Great Life' or 'First Life'), the ineffable source of the World of Light from whom the uthras and all goodness proceed.

hebdomad.def: A group of seven; commonly the seven heavens or seven planetary rulers (archons) governed by the Demiurge, forming the realm just below the Ogdoad.

heimarmene.def: 'Fate'; the oppressive cosmic determinism imposed by the planetary Archons over the material world, binding souls until Gnosis frees them.

hermes.def: 'Thrice-Greatest Hermes'; the legendary sage and revealer, blending the Egyptian Thoth and Greek Hermes, to whom the Hermetic writings of divine wisdom are ascribed.

hermes trismegistus.def: 'Thrice-Greatest Hermes'; the legendary sage and revealer, blending the Egyptian Thoth and Greek Hermes, to whom the Hermetic writings of divine wisdom are ascribed.

hermetic nous.def: In the Hermetica the supreme divine Mind, God as intellect, source of light and life who begets the cosmos and can indwell and elevate the human mind.

hibil.def: A great Mandaean light-being and savior (Hibil Ziwa, 'Hibil the Radiance'), who descends into the worlds of darkness to subdue evil; often equated with the biblical Abel.

hibil ziwa.def: A great Mandaean light-being and savior (Hibil Ziwa, 'Hibil the Radiance'), who descends into the worlds of darkness to subdue evil; often equated with the biblical Abel.

hibil-ziwa.def: A great Mandaean light-being and savior (Hibil Ziwa, 'Hibil the Radiance'), who descends into the worlds of darkness to subdue evil; often equated with the biblical Abel.

horos.def: The 'Limit' or 'Boundary'; a power that separates the Pleroma from the lower deficiency and restores order, also called the Cross (Stauros).

horus (gnostic).def: The 'Limit' or 'Boundary'; a power that separates the Pleroma from the lower deficiency and restores order, also called the Cross (Stauros).

hupsiphrone.def: 'She of High Mind'; a virginal heavenly female figure who descends from her place of virginity into the world, the title character of a fragmentary Nag Hammadi text.

hyle.def: 'Matter'; the base, formless material substance, regarded as the lowest and often evil or ignorant stratum of reality.

hymn of the pearl.def: A celebrated Gnostic-style poem (in the Acts of Thomas) allegorizing the soul's descent into the world, forgetfulness, awakening, and return with the pearl of true self-knowledge.

hypostasis.def: The concrete reality, substance, or underlying existence of a being or principle; used of the 'reality' or 'nature' of the Archons and other powers.

hypsiphrone.def: 'She of High Mind'; a virginal heavenly female figure who descends from her place of virginity into the world, the title character of a fragmentary Nag Hammadi text.

ialdabaoth.def: The chief Archon and Demiurge, lion-faced offspring of Sophia; ignorant of the realm above, he arrogantly declares himself the only God and creates the lower cosmos and its rulers.

ignorance.def: 'Ignorance'; the lack of saving knowledge that binds the soul to matter and the rulers, the condition Gnosis overcomes.

image.def: A reflection or copy of a higher archetype; the material world and the earthly Adam are made as images of divine originals.

imitation spirit.def: The 'imitation spirit' fashioned by the Archons to bind souls to matter through the passions, deceiving them and hindering their ascent.

immovable race.def: The 'unshakeable generation'; the elect spiritual humanity (the seed of Seth) whose true nature cannot be moved by the powers of the lower world.

ineffable.def: The utterly transcendent, unnameable supreme God beyond all attributes and comprehension, knowable only through his self-revelation.

invisible spirit.def: The supreme, ineffable, transcendent God in Sethian cosmology; the unknowable Virgin Spirit from whom Barbelo and all else proceed.

invisible virgin spirit.def: The supreme, ineffable, transcendent God in Sethian cosmology; the unknowable Virgin Spirit from whom Barbelo and all else proceed.

iouel.def: A heavenly angelic being and revealer in Sethian texts (Allogenes, Gospel of the Egyptians), sometimes called 'she of the glories', who instructs the visionary.

jesus (gnostic).def: In Gnostic texts the earthly manifestation joined by or vehicle of the heavenly Christ/Savior, who teaches secret Gnosis to the disciples rather than dying for sin in the orthodox sense.

joshamin.def: A first great emanation among the Mandaean uthras; a lofty light-being who, through a proud aspiration, falls somewhat from his place yet remains in the upper worlds.

kenoma.def: The 'Emptiness' or void; the region of deficiency and lack outside the Pleroma, associated with the material world and the shadow cast by the Fullness.

king of light.def: A Mandaean title for the supreme ruler of the World of Light, the good God who reigns over the realms of radiance.

king of light (mandaean).def: A Mandaean title for the supreme ruler of the World of Light, the good God who reigns over the realms of radiance.

kingdom of light.def: The Manichaean paradise of the Father of Greatness, the eternal Kingdom of Light, opposed to the coeternal Kingdom of Darkness.

kingless race.def: The 'unshakeable generation'; the elect spiritual humanity (the seed of Seth) whose true nature cannot be moved by the powers of the lower world.

knowledge of life.def: 'Knowledge of Life'; the chief redeemer and revealer of the Mandaeans, a personified saving Gnosis sent from the World of Light to teach and rescue souls.

kosmokrator.def: The 'World-Ruler'; a title for the Demiurge or a chief archon as governor of the material cosmos, sometimes identified with the ruler of darkness.

life.def: 'Life'; a feminine divine power often paired with Adam or identified with Eve as the spiritual mother of the living, and linked with the Epinoia of light.

light.def: The divine luminous substance and realm of the true God; the spiritual element imprisoned in matter that salvation seeks to gather and return above.

light mind.def: In Manichaean thought the redeemed spiritual mind awakened in the believer by the Great Nous, which orders the soul's faculties and enables salvation.

light-mind.def: In Manichaean thought the redeemed spiritual mind awakened in the believer by the Great Nous, which orders the soul's faculties and enables salvation.

likeness.def: A resemblance or model; often paired with 'image', as when humanity is fashioned after the likeness of a higher form seen in the waters.

limit.def: An English rendering of Horos; the boundary-power that divides the Fullness from deficiency and consolidates the restored Aeons.

living spirit.def: In Manichaean myth a savior-deity ('Demiurge') evoked by the Father of Greatness who rescues the Primal Man from darkness and fashions the ordered cosmos from the defeated powers.

living water.def: The spiritual water of Gnostic and Mandaean baptism symbolizing life, purification, and the light-realm above, contrasted with the turbid waters of matter.

logos.def: 'Word' or Reason; a divine emanation and mediating principle through which the ineffable Father is expressed and the cosmos ordered.

luminary.def: A great light-being or light-realm; especially the four Luminaries (Harmozel, Oroiael, Daveithai, Eleleth) that surround the Self-Begotten in Sethian cosmology.

malka d-nhura.def: A Mandaean title for the supreme ruler of the World of Light, the good God who reigns over the realms of radiance.

man (aeon).def: 'Man'; a heavenly Aeon and the archetypal divine Human, the celestial pattern after whom the earthly Adam is modeled.

man of nous.def: In the Poimandres the primal luminous Human made in the image of the Father-Mind, who descends and unites with Nature, giving rise to mortal humanity's dual nature.

mana.def: In Mandaean thought the highest formless divine essence or 'Mind/Vessel' (Mana Rabba, the 'Great Mana'), the supreme source of the World of Light.

mana rabba.def: In Mandaean thought the highest formless divine essence or 'Mind/Vessel' (Mana Rabba, the 'Great Mana'), the supreme source of the World of Light.

manda d-hayye.def: 'Knowledge of Life'; the chief redeemer and revealer of the Mandaeans, a personified saving Gnosis sent from the World of Light to teach and rescue souls.

manda d-hiia.def: 'Knowledge of Life'; the chief redeemer and revealer of the Mandaeans, a personified saving Gnosis sent from the World of Light to teach and rescue souls.

mandadhayye.def: 'Knowledge of Life'; the chief redeemer and revealer of the Mandaeans, a personified saving Gnosis sent from the World of Light to teach and rescue souls.

manes.def: The third-century prophet and founder of Manichaeism, who proclaimed himself the 'Apostle of Light' and Seal of the Prophets and composed the religion's dualist scriptures.

mani.def: The third-century prophet and founder of Manichaeism, who proclaimed himself the 'Apostle of Light' and Seal of the Prophets and composed the religion's dualist scriptures.

manichaios.def: The third-century prophet and founder of Manichaeism, who proclaimed himself the 'Apostle of Light' and Seal of the Prophets and composed the religion's dualist scriptures.

mariam.def: A prominent disciple in several Gnostic gospels, portrayed as a favored recipient of Jesus' secret teaching and a spiritual leader among the apostles.

mariamne.def: A prominent disciple in several Gnostic gospels, portrayed as a favored recipient of Jesus' secret teaching and a spiritual leader among the apostles.

marsanes.def: A Sethian prophet-visionary and title figure of a Nag Hammadi tractate who ascends through the levels of reality and expounds the ranks of being and the divine names.

marsianos.def: A Sethian prophet-visionary and title figure of a Nag Hammadi tractate who ascends through the levels of reality and expounds the ranks of being and the divine names.

mary magdalene (gnostic).def: A prominent disciple in several Gnostic gospels, portrayed as a favored recipient of Jesus' secret teaching and a spiritual leader among the apostles.

matter.def: 'Matter'; the base, formless material substance, regarded as the lowest and often evil or ignorant stratum of reality.

meirothea.def: The heavenly Mother of the divine Adamas (and of Seth) in Sethian texts; a maternal light-being of the higher realm.

meirotheos.def: The heavenly Mother of the divine Adamas (and of Seth) in Sethian texts; a maternal light-being of the higher realm.

melchisedek.def: The priest-king of Genesis reinterpreted as a heavenly savior-figure and revealer; the subject of a Nag Hammadi tractate in which he is a warrior-priest of the light.

melchizedek.def: The priest-king of Genesis reinterpreted as a heavenly savior-figure and revealer; the subject of a Nag Hammadi tractate in which he is a warrior-priest of the light.

mellephanea.def: A minister of the light associated with the Luminary Eleleth in Sethian ruler- and angel-lists.

mellephaneus.def: A minister of the light associated with the Luminary Eleleth in Sethian ruler- and angel-lists.

metanoia.def: 'Repentance' or turning of mind; especially the repentance of Sophia, by which the fallen Aeon turns back and begins to be restored.

mind.def: 'Mind' or intellect; a primal Aeon (also called Only-Begotten) that first comprehends the Father, and in philosophy the highest rational faculty.

mirothea.def: The heavenly Mother of the divine Adamas (and of Seth) in Sethian texts; a maternal light-being of the higher realm.

mirotheos.def: The heavenly Mother of the divine Adamas (and of Seth) in Sethian texts; a maternal light-being of the higher realm.

mixture.def: In Manichaean and related dualist thought the present condition in which particles of light are intermingled with darkness/matter, which salvation works to separate.

monad.def: The primal One; the single, undivided ultimate source of all being from which the divine unfolds.

monogenes.def: The 'Only-Begotten'; the first-born Mind (Nous) emanated by the primal Father, sole being able to comprehend the Depth and reveal it to the other Aeons.

mother.def: The primal feminine principle of the Godhead, often Barbelo or Sophia, the maternal source from whom the Aeons and spiritual beings are brought forth.

mother of life.def: A Manichaean deity evoked by the Father of Greatness, who brings forth the Primal Man to face the darkness.

mother of the living.def: A Manichaean deity evoked by the Father of Greatness, who brings forth the Primal Man to face the darkness.

nebro.def: A demonic ruler in Sethian and related texts (notably the Gospel of Judas), a defiled power who together with Saklas begets the rulers of the lower world.

nebro-el.def: A demonic ruler in Sethian and related texts (notably the Gospel of Judas), a defiled power who together with Saklas begets the rulers of the lower world.

nebruel.def: A demonic ruler in Sethian and related texts (notably the Gospel of Judas), a defiled power who together with Saklas begets the rulers of the lower world.

noraia.def: The spiritual daughter of Adam and Eve (sister-wife of Seth); a virginal savior-figure who resists the Archons and represents the undefiled Gnostic lineage.

norea.def: The spiritual daughter of Adam and Eve (sister-wife of Seth); a virginal savior-figure who resists the Archons and represents the undefiled Gnostic lineage.

nous.def: 'Mind' or intellect; a primal Aeon (also called Only-Begotten) that first comprehends the Father, and in philosophy the highest rational faculty.

nous (hermetic).def: In the Hermetica the supreme divine Mind, God as intellect, source of light and life who begets the cosmos and can indwell and elevate the human mind.

nous (manichaean).def: In Manichaeism the supreme saving Mind, the redeeming intelligence sent to awaken and organize the Light-Mind within the elect.

ogdoad.def: A group of eight; in various systems the eighth sphere or heaven above the seven, a place of rest and spiritual ascent, or a primal group of eight divine beings.

ogdoad and ennead.def: The eighth and ninth heavenly spheres in Hermetic mysticism; realms of light and praise above the seven planetary heavens, reached in a visionary ascent (as in the tractate 'The Discourse on the Eighth and Ninth').

only begotten.def: The 'Only-Begotten'; the first-born Mind (Nous) emanated by the primal Father, sole being able to comprehend the Depth and reveal it to the other Aeons.

only-begotten.def: The 'Only-Begotten'; the first-born Mind (Nous) emanated by the primal Father, sole being able to comprehend the Depth and reveal it to the other Aeons.

only-begotten son.def: A title for the Only-Begotten or Christ as the cherished Son emanated to reveal the Father within the Fullness.

oraios.def: One of the seven planetary Archons ranked among the rulers begotten by Yaldabaoth.

orea.def: The spiritual daughter of Adam and Eve (sister-wife of Seth); a virginal savior-figure who resists the Archons and represents the undefiled Gnostic lineage.

oriael.def: The second of the four Luminaries in Sethian cosmology, a light-realm associated with the placement of Seth or a heavenly Adam.

oroiael.def: The second of the four Luminaries in Sethian cosmology, a light-realm associated with the placement of Seth or a heavenly Adam.

oroiel.def: The second of the four Luminaries in Sethian cosmology, a light-realm associated with the placement of Seth or a heavenly Adam.

parable of the pearl.def: A celebrated Gnostic-style poem (in the Acts of Thomas) allegorizing the soul's descent into the world, forgetfulness, awakening, and return with the pearl of true self-knowledge.

passion.def: The suffering and disordered emotion (grief, fear, confusion, desire) produced by Sophia's fall, from which the material substances of the lower world are formed.

pigera-adamas.def: The heavenly, perfect primal Human (Pigeradamas, the 'holy Adam'); the divine archetype of humanity within the Pleroma, distinct from the earthly Adam.

pigeradamas.def: The heavenly, perfect primal Human (Pigeradamas, the 'holy Adam'); the divine archetype of humanity within the Pleroma, distinct from the earthly Adam.

pillar of glory.def: In Manichaean cosmology the luminous pillar (associated with the Milky Way) up which liberated light-particles and purified souls ascend from the world toward the realm of light.

pistis.def: 'Faith'; a divine feminine power (often 'Pistis Sophia', Faith-Wisdom) of the higher realm whose reflection in the waters below the Demiurge unwittingly imitates.

pistis sophia.def: 'Faith-Wisdom'; both a title for the fallen-and-repentant Sophia and the name of a major Coptic Gnostic text recounting her repentances and the risen Jesus' teachings.

pistis-sophia.def: 'Faith-Wisdom'; both a title for the fallen-and-repentant Sophia and the name of a major Coptic Gnostic text recounting her repentances and the risen Jesus' teachings.

place of rest.def: 'Rest' or repose; the state of final tranquility and fulfillment attained by the redeemed soul upon returning to the Fullness.

pleroma.def: The 'Fullness'; the complete spiritual realm of the divine, comprising all the Aeons that emanate from the ultimate God, as opposed to the deficient material cosmos below.

pneuma.def: 'Spirit'; the highest, breath-like divine element, the spiritual essence in human beings that belongs to the world of light.

poemandres.def: The divine revealer ('Shepherd of Men' or 'Mind of the Sovereignty') who discloses the origin of the cosmos and the way of salvation to Hermes in the first Hermetic treatise.

poimandres.def: The divine revealer ('Shepherd of Men' or 'Mind of the Sovereignty') who discloses the origin of the cosmos and the way of salvation to Hermes in the first Hermetic treatise.

poimandres nous.def: In the Poimandres the primal luminous Human made in the image of the Father-Mind, who descends and unites with Nature, giving rise to mortal humanity's dual nature.

power.def: A cosmic force or being (dynamis); either a hostile ruling force of the lower world or, positively, an emanation of divine energy.

primal man.def: The first evoked being in Manichaean cosmology, sent to battle the darkness; defeated and stripped of his light-armor, his rescue and the recovery of the lost light drive the cosmic drama.

pronoia.def: 'Forethought' or Providence; a divine feminine power, often identified with Barbelo, whose provident care descends to awaken and rescue the sparks of light.

propator.def: The 'Fore-Father'; the primal ancestral God before all Aeons, another name for the ineffable source (Bythos) of the Fullness.

prophania.def: A heavenly being or emanation named in Sethian sources among the powers of the divine realm, associated with the appearing of light.

protennoia.def: The 'First Thought' of the Father; a primal feminine emanation who descends through the realms as a revealer and savior, central to the text Trimorphic Protennoia.

protophania.def: The 'First Thought' of the Father; a primal feminine emanation who descends through the realms as a revealer and savior, central to the text Trimorphic Protennoia.

protophania (aeon).def: A heavenly being or emanation named in Sethian sources among the powers of the divine realm, associated with the appearing of light.

psyche.def: 'Soul'; the animating psychic element intermediate between spirit and body, capable of turning either toward the spiritual or the material.

ptahil.def: The Mandaean demiurge-figure, an uthra who fashions the material world and the body of Adam; well-meaning but flawed, he works with darker powers and requires correction.

ptahil-uthra.def: The Mandaean demiurge-figure, an uthra who fashions the material world and the body of Adam; well-meaning but flawed, he works with darker powers and requires correction.

pymander.def: The divine revealer ('Shepherd of Men' or 'Mind of the Sovereignty') who discloses the origin of the cosmos and the way of salvation to Hermes in the first Hermetic treatise.

realm of light.def: The Manichaean paradise of the Father of Greatness, the eternal Kingdom of Light, opposed to the coeternal Kingdom of Darkness.

repentance.def: 'Repentance' or turning of mind; especially the repentance of Sophia, by which the fallen Aeon turns back and begins to be restored.

repose.def: 'Rest' or repose; the state of final tranquility and fulfillment attained by the redeemed soul upon returning to the Fullness.

restoration.def: The final 'Restoration'; the ultimate return of all fallen spiritual elements to the Fullness and the healing of every deficiency.

revealer.def: A savior-figure sent from the higher realm to impart saving knowledge and awaken the elect from ignorance and sleep.

ruha.def: The Mandaean female spirit of the lower world; a fallen, seductive power (mother of the planets and signs) who rules the material realm and opposes the world of light.

ruha d-qudsha.def: The Mandaean female spirit of the lower world; a fallen, seductive power (mother of the planets and signs) who rules the material realm and opposes the world of light.

ruler.def: An English rendering of Archon; one of the world-governing powers subordinate to the Demiurge.

sabaoth.def: A son of Yaldabaoth who, upon seeing the power of the higher realm, repents and condemns his father, and is exalted to rule in a higher heaven of righteousness.

sakla.def: A name (meaning 'fool') for the Demiurge or a chief ruler, expressing his blind ignorance; sometimes a distinct ruler alongside Yaldabaoth and Nebro.

saklas.def: A name (meaning 'fool') for the Demiurge or a chief ruler, expressing his blind ignorance; sometimes a distinct ruler alongside Yaldabaoth and Nebro.

samael.def: A name (meaning 'blind god' or 'god of the blind') for the Demiurge Yaldabaoth, emphasizing his blindness to the true God above.

sarx.def: 'Flesh'; the physical, fleshly body, associated with the material realm and the passions, often disparaged in Gnostic anthropology.

savior.def: The redeeming being (Soter), often the Christ or a heavenly emanation, who descends to bring Gnosis and lead the spiritual back to the Fullness.

seal.def: A mark of ownership, protection, or initiation; in Gnostic and baptismal ritual a spiritual sealing that secures the soul and enables its ascent.

seed.def: The spiritual lineage of Gnostic humanity descended from Seth; the elect race bearing the divine spark, destined for salvation and return to the light.

seed of seth.def: The spiritual lineage of Gnostic humanity descended from Seth; the elect race bearing the divine spark, destined for salvation and return to the light.

self-begotten.def: The 'Self-Begotten' or Self-Generated One; the divine Son who arises within Barbelo, often identified with the heavenly Christ, surrounded by the four Luminaries.

separation.def: The redemptive un-mixing of light from darkness; the cosmic process by which the imprisoned light is extracted from matter and restored to its realm.

seth.def: The heavenly and earthly son of Adam revered as the spiritual father and savior of the Gnostic race (the 'seed of Seth'); the Great Seth is his exalted heavenly counterpart.

sethel.def: The heavenly and earthly son of Adam revered as the spiritual father and savior of the Gnostic race (the 'seed of Seth'); the Great Seth is his exalted heavenly counterpart.

seven archons.def: The seven planetary Archons (a Hebdomad) created by Yaldabaoth to govern the seven heavens, each bearing a name and monstrous form.

seven rulers.def: The seven planetary Archons (a Hebdomad) created by Yaldabaoth to govern the seven heavens, each bearing a name and monstrous form.

shitel.def: A Mandaean uthra (light-being) identified with the biblical Seth; a pure heavenly figure and son of Adam in Mandaean lore.

shitil.def: A Mandaean uthra (light-being) identified with the biblical Seth; a pure heavenly figure and son of Adam in Mandaean lore.

sige.def: 'Silence'; the female consort (syzygy) of the primal Depth (Bythos) in Valentinian thought, the receptive stillness from which the Aeons are conceived.

sigē.def: 'Silence'; the female consort (syzygy) of the primal Depth (Bythos) in Valentinian thought, the receptive stillness from which the Aeons are conceived.

silence.def: An English rendering of Sige; the primal quiet paired with the Depth, receptive ground of the first emanations.

sitil.def: A Mandaean uthra (light-being) identified with the biblical Seth; a pure heavenly figure and son of Adam in Mandaean lore.

son.def: The divine offspring of the Father (and Mother/Barbelo), often the Self-Begotten or Christ, the third member of the primal triad and revealer of the Father.

sophia.def: 'Wisdom'; the youngest Aeon whose passionate desire to know the Father leads to her fall and the accidental generation of the Demiurge, setting the cosmic drama in motion.

sophia zoe.def: 'Wisdom-Life'; a title combining Sophia and Zoe for the spiritual mother-figure who imparts life and knowledge, prominent in 'On the Origin of the World'.

sophia-zoe.def: 'Wisdom-Life'; a title combining Sophia and Zoe for the spiritual mother-figure who imparts life and knowledge, prominent in 'On the Origin of the World'.

soter.def: The redeeming being (Soter), often the Christ or a heavenly emanation, who descends to bring Gnosis and lead the spiritual back to the Fullness.

soul.def: 'Soul'; the animating psychic element intermediate between spirit and body, capable of turning either toward the spiritual or the material.

spark.def: The fragment of divine light or spirit trapped within a human being; awakening this spark through Gnosis is the aim of Gnostic salvation.

spark of light.def: The fragment of divine light or spirit trapped within a human being; awakening this spark through Gnosis is the aim of Gnostic salvation.

spirit.def: 'Spirit'; the highest, breath-like divine element, the spiritual essence in human beings that belongs to the world of light.

spiritual eve.def: The first woman; in Gnostic myth often a spiritual figure (linked with Zoe/Life and the Epinoia of light) who awakens Adam to knowledge, distinguished from the merely fleshly Eve.

stauros.def: The 'Cross'; in Valentinian usage a limiting and stabilizing power (identified with Horos/Limit) that fences the Fullness and supports the Aeons, distinct from the wooden cross.

syzygy.def: A male-female pair or conjugal couple of Aeons within the Pleroma; the pairing expresses divine wholeness, and separation from one's syzygy is a source of deficiency.

tetrad.def: A grouping of four; in Valentinian thought the primal four Aeons (such as Depth, Silence, Mind, Truth) from which the Pleroma unfolds.

the all.def: The totality of divine being, the Entirety; a term for the sum of the Aeons and the Fullness taken as one whole.

the christ.def: The 'Anointed'; the heavenly redeemer and revealer of Gnosis, frequently identified with the Self-Begotten (Autogenes) or a saving Aeon who descends to awaken humanity.

the column of glory.def: In Manichaean cosmology the luminous pillar (associated with the Milky Way) up which liberated light-particles and purified souls ascend from the world toward the realm of light.

the cosmos.def: The ordered material universe; in Gnostic thought a lower, often flawed or prison-like realm fashioned by the Demiurge, contrasted with the spiritual Fullness.

the darkness.def: The primordial realm or power opposed to the light; in dualist systems a coeternal evil principle, in others the ignorance and matter below the Fullness.

the depth.def: An English rendering of Bythos; the unfathomable primal Father, ultimate abyss-like source of the Aeons.

the elect.def: The spiritually mature believers (especially in Manichaeism) who bear and liberate the light and are assured of return to the realm of light.

the ennead.def: The ninth sphere or heaven in Hermetic cosmology, a realm of the divine reached beyond the Ogdoad in the mystic's ascent.

the fall (sophia).def: The primal error, especially Sophia's misguided desire, that produces deficiency, the Demiurge, and the material world; the disruption whose repair is the goal of the drama.

the father.def: The ultimate, unbegotten source of all divine being; the transcendent origin beyond name and comprehension in Gnostic theology.

the father of greatness.def: The supreme good God of Manichaeism, ruler of the Realm of Light, who initiates the series of divine evocations to combat the invading darkness.

the five seals.def: A Sethian baptismal rite and mystery of enlightenment; a fivefold sealing that confers illumination, protection, and incorporation into the realm of light.

the great nous.def: In Manichaeism the supreme saving Mind, the redeeming intelligence sent to awaken and organize the Light-Mind within the elect.

the great seth.def: The heavenly and earthly son of Adam revered as the spiritual father and savior of the Gnostic race (the 'seed of Seth'); the Great Seth is his exalted heavenly counterpart.

the ineffable.def: The utterly transcendent, unnameable supreme God beyond all attributes and comprehension, knowable only through his self-revelation.

the invisible spirit.def: The supreme, ineffable, transcendent God in Sethian cosmology; the unknowable Virgin Spirit from whom Barbelo and all else proceed.

the life.def: The supreme deity of the Mandaeans (the 'Great Life' or 'First Life'), the ineffable source of the World of Light from whom the uthras and all goodness proceed.

the light.def: The divine luminous substance and realm of the true God; the spiritual element imprisoned in matter that salvation seeks to gather and return above.

the light-mind.def: In Manichaean thought the redeemed spiritual mind awakened in the believer by the Great Nous, which orders the soul's faculties and enables salvation.

the living spirit.def: In Manichaean myth a savior-deity ('Demiurge') evoked by the Father of Greatness who rescues the Primal Man from darkness and fashions the ordered cosmos from the defeated powers.

the mixture.def: In Manichaean and related dualist thought the present condition in which particles of light are intermingled with darkness/matter, which salvation works to separate.

the mother.def: The primal feminine principle of the Godhead, often Barbelo or Sophia, the maternal source from whom the Aeons and spiritual beings are brought forth.

the mother of life.def: A Manichaean deity evoked by the Father of Greatness, who brings forth the Primal Man to face the darkness.

the ogdoad and the ennead.def: The eighth and ninth heavenly spheres in Hermetic mysticism; realms of light and praise above the seven planetary heavens, reached in a visionary ascent (as in the tractate 'The Discourse on the Eighth and Ninth').

the pearl.def: A celebrated Gnostic-style poem (in the Acts of Thomas) allegorizing the soul's descent into the world, forgetfulness, awakening, and return with the pearl of true self-knowledge.

the primal man.def: The first evoked being in Manichaean cosmology, sent to battle the darkness; defeated and stripped of his light-armor, his rescue and the recovery of the lost light drive the cosmic drama.

the revealer.def: A savior-figure sent from the higher realm to impart saving knowledge and awaken the elect from ignorance and sleep.

the savior.def: The redeeming being (Soter), often the Christ or a heavenly emanation, who descends to bring Gnosis and lead the spiritual back to the Fullness.

the seed.def: The spiritual lineage of Gnostic humanity descended from Seth; the elect race bearing the divine spark, destined for salvation and return to the light.

the self-begotten.def: The 'Self-Begotten' or Self-Generated One; the divine Son who arises within Barbelo, often identified with the heavenly Christ, surrounded by the four Luminaries.

the separation.def: The redemptive un-mixing of light from darkness; the cosmic process by which the imprisoned light is extracted from matter and restored to its realm.

the seven.def: The seven planetary Archons (a Hebdomad) created by Yaldabaoth to govern the seven heavens, each bearing a name and monstrous form.

the son.def: The divine offspring of the Father (and Mother/Barbelo), often the Self-Begotten or Christ, the third member of the primal triad and revealer of the Father.

the third messenger.def: A Manichaean savior-deity of the second evocation who sets the cosmic machinery of light-liberation in motion, drawing the imprisoned light out of the world.

the thirteenth aeon.def: A realm above the twelve, associated with the repentant Sophia's place of exile and turning; in some texts (e.g. Pistis Sophia) the region from which she falls and to which she is restored.

the twelve.def: The twelve Archons or authorities set over the zodiac and the lower cosmos, subordinate to the Demiurge.

third messenger.def: A Manichaean savior-deity of the second evocation who sets the cosmic machinery of light-liberation in motion, drawing the imprisoned light out of the world.

thirteenth aeon.def: A realm above the twelve, associated with the repentant Sophia's place of exile and turning; in some texts (e.g. Pistis Sophia) the region from which she falls and to which she is restored.

thirteenth realm.def: A realm above the twelve, associated with the repentant Sophia's place of exile and turning; in some texts (e.g. Pistis Sophia) the region from which she falls and to which she is restored.

thomas (didymos).def: The apostle 'Thomas the Twin', presented in the Gospel of Thomas and related texts as the recipient and transmitter of Jesus' hidden sayings.

thought.def: 'Thought' or intention; the first conception within the divine Mind, a feminine principle that is the Father's inward thought of himself.

treasury.def: A storehouse of light or spiritual goods; the Treasury of Light is a high realm where redeemed souls and light-particles are gathered.

triad.def: A grouping of three divine principles or beings, such as Father, Mother, and Son in certain Gnostic systems.

trismegistus.def: 'Thrice-Greatest Hermes'; the legendary sage and revealer, blending the Egyptian Thoth and Greek Hermes, to whom the Hermetic writings of divine wisdom are ascribed.

truth.def: 'Truth'; a primal Aeon, frequently the female consort of Mind (Nous) in the founding Tetrad of the Valentinian Pleroma.

twelve archons.def: The twelve Archons or authorities set over the zodiac and the lower cosmos, subordinate to the Demiurge.

twelve rulers.def: The twelve Archons or authorities set over the zodiac and the lower cosmos, subordinate to the Demiurge.

unknowable god.def: The utterly transcendent, unnameable supreme God beyond all attributes and comprehension, knowable only through his self-revelation.

unshakeable race.def: The 'unshakeable generation'; the elect spiritual humanity (the seed of Seth) whose true nature cannot be moved by the powers of the lower world.

uthra.def: A Mandaean light-being or benevolent spirit ('wealth' or 'excellency'), one of the many divine helpers and messengers who inhabit and serve the World of Light.

uthras.def: A Mandaean light-being or benevolent spirit ('wealth' or 'excellency'), one of the many divine helpers and messengers who inhabit and serve the World of Light.

utra.def: A Mandaean light-being or benevolent spirit ('wealth' or 'excellency'), one of the many divine helpers and messengers who inhabit and serve the World of Light.

veil.def: A boundary or curtain separating spiritual regions, such as the veil dividing the world of the Demiurge from the higher realms above.

water of life.def: The spiritual water of Gnostic and Mandaean baptism symbolizing life, purification, and the light-realm above, contrasted with the turbid waters of matter.

wisdom.def: 'Wisdom'; the youngest Aeon whose passionate desire to know the Father leads to her fall and the accidental generation of the Demiurge, setting the cosmic drama in motion.

word.def: 'Word' or Reason; a divine emanation and mediating principle through which the ineffable Father is expressed and the cosmos ordered.

world of darkness.def: The Mandaean realm of chaos, evil, and turbid waters ruled by dark powers, the counterpart and opponent of the World of Light.

world of darkness (mandaean).def: The Mandaean realm of chaos, evil, and turbid waters ruled by dark powers, the counterpart and opponent of the World of Light.

world of light.def: The Mandaean heavenly realm of radiance, life, and purity; the abode of the Great Life, the King of Light, and the uthras, opposed to the World of Darkness.

world of light (mandaean).def: The Mandaean heavenly realm of radiance, life, and purity; the abode of the Great Life, the King of Light, and the uthras, opposed to the World of Darkness.

world-ruler.def: The 'World-Ruler'; a title for the Demiurge or a chief archon as governor of the material cosmos, sometimes identified with the ruler of darkness.

yaldabaoth.def: The chief Archon and Demiurge, lion-faced offspring of Sophia; ignorant of the realm above, he arrogantly declares himself the only God and creates the lower cosmos and its rulers.

yaltabaoth.def: The chief Archon and Demiurge, lion-faced offspring of Sophia; ignorant of the realm above, he arrogantly declares himself the only God and creates the lower cosmos and its rulers.

yao.def: One of the seven Archons under the Demiurge, a ruler-name derived from the Hebrew divine name Yah.

yoel.def: A heavenly angelic being and revealer in Sethian texts (Allogenes, Gospel of the Egyptians), sometimes called 'she of the glories', who instructs the visionary.

youel.def: A heavenly angelic being and revealer in Sethian texts (Allogenes, Gospel of the Egyptians), sometimes called 'she of the glories', who instructs the visionary.

yushamin.def: A first great emanation among the Mandaean uthras; a lofty light-being who, through a proud aspiration, falls somewhat from his place yet remains in the upper worlds.

yushamīn.def: A first great emanation among the Mandaean uthras; a lofty light-being who, through a proud aspiration, falls somewhat from his place yet remains in the upper worlds.

zoe.def: 'Life'; a feminine divine power often paired with Adam or identified with Eve as the spiritual mother of the living, and linked with the Epinoia of light.

zoe-eve.def: The first woman; in Gnostic myth often a spiritual figure (linked with Zoe/Life and the Epinoia of light) who awakens Adam to knowledge, distinguished from the merely fleshly Eve.

zostrianos.def: A Sethian seer and title character of a Nag Hammadi apocalypse who ascends through the heavenly realms, receives baptisms, and learns the structure of the divine world.

zostrianus.def: A Sethian seer and title character of a Nag Hammadi apocalypse who ascends through the heavenly realms, receives baptisms, and learns the structure of the divine world.
